title: Uruguayan Hake Bake
description: A simple and flavorful Uruguayan-inspired dish featuring hake baked with sweet and juicy flavors.
instructions: Season the hake fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a baking dish over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the hake fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the baking dish to the preheated oven.
Bake for 8-10 minutes or until the hake is cooked through.
While the hake is baking, mix the chimichurri sauce and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Remove the hake from the oven and brush the chimichurri sauce mixture on top.
Serve the hake with a slice of Uruguayan sweet bread on the side.
